favourite.heading: Why Cincinnati can pull away
bullets: Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 7.6 points to Cincinnati (+7.6 pts).

Cincinnati is the better football team by 5.8 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+5.8 pts).
Playing at Cincinnati is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Cincinnati by 0.6 points: ball control vs front disruption (+0.6 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Miami (OH) can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -5.0 to p90 +39.0 for Cincinnati, so a projection of +18.0 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.

The market disagrees by 4.5 points. The market is not the truth, but a gap that large is more often the model missing information (a suspension, a starter, a scheme change) than the market being wrong.
